conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_END_CANDIDATE_ON_YES_ORDER: The five revocation candidates are the annual Iran continuation notices of March 2021 through March 2025 (FRDOC 2021-05037, 2022-04907, 2023-05300, 2024-05568, 2025-04104). Each notice recites that Executive Order 13716 revoked Executive Orders 13574, 13590, 13622 and 13645 and provisions of Executive Order 13628 and that Executive Order 13846 revoked Executive Orders 13716 and 13628. None of those sentences revokes, amends or supersedes Executive Order 13949; the notices list Executive Order 13949 only as one of the orders under which additional steps were taken to deal with the national emergency. The candidates therefore do not end any clause.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 13949 (September 21, 2020, 85 FR 60043) blocks property of persons engaged in conventional-arms activities involving Iran. The order is operative on 2026-10-14. Its text contains no sunset, expiry condition or revocation trigger, and section 5 and section 7 tie it to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957 of March 15, 1995, which has been continued each year; the held continuation notices of March 5, 2021 (86 FR 13621) and March 2, 2026 (91 FR 10937) show the emergency was continued beyond March 15, 2026, a date after the cutoff. The notices of March 2022 (FRDOC 2022-04907), March 2023 (2023-05300), March 2024 (2024-05568) and March 2025 (2025-04104) are held under jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts and name this order in the same recital, so the chain is unbroken from the order's signing; they are not packet-citable evidence ids and are not cited as events. Later Iran orders that cite Executive Order 13949 recite it and add or restate other measures; Executive Order 14382 of February 6, 2026, which the March 2, 2026 notice lists, does not mention Executive Order 13949 or revoke, amend or supersede it, and the held Executive Order 14389 of February 20, 2026 ends tariff actions and does not mention it. The U.S. Code note under 50 U.S.C. 1701 lists this order among the Iran orders in the table of executive orders. The Federal Register disposition note for this order lists only cross-references (Executive Orders 12170, 12281, 12957 and the Notice of March 2, 2026) and no revocation, amendment or supersession.
